fields.title: Make Q4 our biggest revenue quarter
fields.summary: Net revenue is on pace at $1.38M; margin is creeping up as freight costs fall.

fields.title: Keep customers coming back
fields.summary: Subscriber churn rose to 9.6% after the October price change; repeat purchase is flat.

fields.title: Run a leaner operation
fields.summary: Cost per order is down 45 cents since the carrier switch.

fields.title: Win Black Friday on our own store
fields.summary: List growth and conversion are fine; paid ads are spending more than they return.

fields.title: Open 40 new wholesale doors
fields.summary: Pipeline is strong, but only 9 stores have signed; most buyers decide after their holiday sets.

fields.title: Ship every order within 48 hours
fields.summary: The Monday backlog is the bottleneck; two hero SKUs keep running out.

fields.title: Answer every customer the same day
fields.summary: Ticket volume is up 40% since mid-October and first replies are slipping past 6 pm.

fields.title: Grow the repeat-buyer program
fields.summary: Repeat rate moved one point; the refill reminder flow launches next week.
